description: A named person is personal data and is never a register entry, even when the card is about them starting something. The organisation is proposable; the individual never is.

cards.headline: Dr Naledi Khumalo leaves a Big Four practice to lead a new analytics venture
cards.so_what: A senior departure that may signal a new competitor forming

expected_output.shape: single JSON object with keys horizon_days, candidates

rubric.condition: Zero occurrences of the exact strings "Dr Naledi Khumalo" or "Naledi Khumalo" in any candidate's name field — an individual is personal data, never a register entry.
The candidates array contains exactly 0 items — the card names no organisation, so there is nothing left to propose once the individual is excluded.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 6, and matching the no-named-individual rule functions 11 and 13 already carry.
